resolved_conflicts.explanation: NHLR's description says 1936 and its build field says 1942; the Fire Lookout Museum says a tree platform went up in 1936 and the tower was built in 1942. Kept 1942 as the tower build year and recorded 1936 as the platform. The Register does not say which is which.
NHLR gives 6,783 ft (2,067 m) and firelookout.com gives 6814 ft. Kept the NHLR figure, which matches the record's 2067.5 m.

NHLR's description spells the association Blackfeet; the 1954 and later clips and firelookout.com say Blackfoot Forest Protective or Protection Association. The Blackfoot spelling is used in the story.

sources.title: Saddle Mtn. Fire Lookout Tower (SADDLE MOUNTAIN LOOKOUT)

notes_for_editor: Several Montana towers are named Saddle Mountain. firelookout.com 369 (Lake County, tower gone 1969) and 389a (Bitterroot, 1941-1972) are different towers and were not used. The record's -2 suffix matches this Powell County tower. The 1954 to 1982 clips come from the Forest Lookouts page and are transcribed from Montana newspapers; originals not checked. The firelookout.com page is undated, so staffing as_of is undated. No notable fires found in two searches. The Forest Lookouts page has a Removed line beside an NGS survey mark record; it was read as a survey mark note, not a tower status. A 2026 Montana feature article was read and does not mention this tower, so it is not cited. Public access is not stated by any source read; no access level is set. Story is about 300 words before footnotes.
